detachmentRule.name: Paragons of Terror
detachmentRule.rule: Steeped in the dark powers of the warp, bred into bloodlines who make a tradition of cruelty and a virtue of malice, these merciless warriors delight in spreading fear and dismay.

enhancements.name: Nightmare’s Master
enhancements.description: The mere sight of this warrior and their steed upon the battlefield, even the rumour of their coming, is enough to put the foe to flight. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. At the start of the Fight phase , each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test .

enhancements.name: Tyrant’s Shadow
enhancements.description: Once this despotic warlord lays claim to territory, their warp-infused will taints the very land itself and resists those who seek to defy them. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. At the end of your Command phase , select one objective marker the bearer is within range of and that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. In addition, until you lose control of that objective marker, it has the Deathly Terror ability as if it were a CHAOS KNIGHTS model from your army.

enhancements.name: Malevolent Heraldry
enhancements.description: Inscribed by Idolators schooled in dark arts, these unholy blazons burn themselves into the gaze of the foe and trigger nausea, disorientation and stark, unreasoning terror. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Each time you roll dice to randomly select which Dread abilities are active for your army, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one or both results rolled.

enhancements.name: Veil of Medrengard
enhancements.description: Said to have been fashioned upon Perturabo’s own daemon world, this baroque device projects an energy barrier of greater power than a standard ion shield. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks, and a 5+ invulnerable save against melee attacks.

stratagems.name: PTERRORSHADES
stratagems.description: Shrieking with hunger, Pterrorshades descend in a whirlwind to feast on the fearful souls of the foe. Their banquet transmutes into vital energy that flows into the Chaos Knight on which they roost.
stratagems.WHEN: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test .
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.EFFECT: Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound and one model in your unit regains up to 1 lost wound.
stratagems.RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round .

stratagems.name: CONQUERORS WITHOUT MERCY
stratagems.description: Chaos Knights leave only death and devastation in their wake, and reduce entire worlds to ruin.
stratagems.WHEN: Fight phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS model from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by your model by 1. After your model has finished making its attacks this phase, if it destroyed one or more enemy units this phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your model must take a Battle-shock test .

stratagems.name: DISDAIN FOR THE WEAK
stratagems.description: Fallen Nobles sneer at the pathetic efforts of their foes, doubly so in the case of those who fear them.
stratagems.WHEN: Fight phase , just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks made by Battle-shocked models.

stratagems.name: A LONG LEASH
stratagems.description: The neural connections between Fallen Nobles and doggedly loyal or fearful War Dog pilots can extend over remarkable distances.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Command phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One ABHORRENT unit from your army and up to two friendly WAR DOG units.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, those WAR DOG units are treated as being within range of any Aura abilities your ABHORRENT unit has.

stratagems.name: IMPERIOUS ADVANCE
stratagems.description: Employing piloting skill or brute force, Fallen Nobles can either manoeuvre or simply barge their steeds through foes and obstacles alike.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase .
stratagems.TARGET: Up to two WAR DOG units from your army or one TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units makes a Normal , Advance , Fall Back or Charge move , it can move through models and terrain features . When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless it made a Charge move, cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed (the Super-heavy Walker ability does not apply while using this Stratagem).

stratagems.name: STORM OF DARKNESS
stratagems.description: Through dark rituals and dread pacts, the Chaos Knights draw upon the fear and despair of their foes and bind it into a curse upon the land itself, wreathing themselves in a shrouding pall.
stratagems.WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase , just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Stealth ability, and each time an attack targets your unit, models in it have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

detachmentRule.name: Malefic Surge
detachmentRule.rule: Calling upon heretical - often supernatural - powers, these Knights are infused with strange and terrible might.

enhancements.name: Knight Diabolus
enhancements.description: Whether through duelling monstrous foes or thanks to unnatural enhancements and boons, this Fallen Noble and their steed have become powerful indeed. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1. While the bearer is using the Diabolic Power ability, its melee weapons have the [LANCE] ability.

enhancements.name: Blasphemous Engine
enhancements.description: In rituals that took centuries to conduct, Idolators and dark priests have bound a greater daemon within the reactor of this Chaos Knight, allowing the war machine to syphon the roiling power of the caged entity. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Add 2 to the bearer’s Wounds characteristic. Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Malefic Surge , you can re-roll the Leadership test taken to see if it suffers any mortal wounds .

enhancements.name: Fleshmetal Fusion
enhancements.description: This Knight is a terrifying blend of daemonic flesh and warp-hardened machine, its pilot unable to leave their Throne until death - or something darker - takes them. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Add 1 to the bearer’s Toughness characteristic. While the bearer is using the Unnatural Fortitude ability, each time an attack with a Damage characteristic of 1 is allocated to the bearer, add 1 to any armour saving throw made against that attack.

enhancements.name: Bestial Aspect
enhancements.description: The machine spirit of this Knight suit has become so ferocious and blood-hungry that it now moves and hunts like a monstrous beast. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer’s ranged weapons have the [assault] ability. While the bearer is using the Unholy Hunger ability, it can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and/or to Advance rolls made for its unit.

stratagems.name: PROFANE SYMBIOSIS
stratagems.description: Some Fallen Nobles are conjoined, symbiotically or parasitically, with the hideous systems of their Chaos Knight. This allows them to channel more unholy energies, though not without risk.
stratagems.WHEN: End of any phase.
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that is not Empowered .
stratagems.EFFECT: Your unit makes a Malefic Surge .
stratagems.RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this Stratagem more than once per battle round .

stratagems.name: HELLFORGED CONSTRUCTION
stratagems.description: Reinforced with warp-infused materials and warded through ritual blood sacrifice, these Chaos Knights can withstand unnatural levels of punishment.
stratagems.WHEN: Fight phase , just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: CORRUPTING TAINT
stratagems.description: The foul energies and unnatural influence of the Chaos Knights spread from them like sorcerous radiation, tainting all they touch.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Command phase , just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army makes a Malefic Surge .
stratagems.TARGET: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.EFFECT: Select one objective marker your unit is within range of that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: UNLEASH BALEFIRE
stratagems.description: These weapons bathe the target in blasts of daemonic balefire that burns flesh and soul alike.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Shooting phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.EFFECT: After your unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test ; if the test is failed, until the end of your opponent’s next turn, it is aflame. While a unit is aflame, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

stratagems.name: WARP VISION
stratagems.description: Supernatural sensors perceive the soul-spoor of their prey, or even stare forward through fate and time.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Shooting phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

stratagems.name: DIABOLIC BULWARK
stratagems.description: Ectoplasmic blood surges hot through glowing conduits as the Fallen Noble feeds power to their Knight suit’s supernaturally enhanced ion shield emitters.
stratagems.WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase , just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save .

detachmentRule.name: Tyrannical Court
detachmentRule.rule: Every one of these egomaniacal warriors seeks to claim all the battlefield glory for themselves, at any cost.

enhancements.name: Throne Mechanicum of Skulls
enhancements.description: Flowing from this brazen Throne, an all-consuming need for murder grips the pilot and never lets go. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit. In addition, once per battle, in your Charge phase , the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer’s unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced .

enhancements.name: Blade of Celerity
enhancements.description: Inlaid with esoteric circuitry, this relic sword is sheathed within the mechanisms of the pilot’s Throne where it imbues the Knight suit with flowing swiftness. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer’s ranged weapons have the [ASSAULT] ability. In addition, once per battle, in the Fight phase , the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Warp-borne Stalker
enhancements.description: Daemonic whispers guide this Knights pilot through the empyric tempests, straight into battle. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has the Deep Strike ability. In addition, once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves .

enhancements.name: Putrid Carapace
enhancements.description: Blessed by Nurgle, the Chaos God of plague and despair, the hide of this Knight suit is thickened with steadily regenerating layers of rust and rotting blubber. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+. In addition, once per battle, at the start of either player’s Command phase , the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer regains up to D6 lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Mirror of Fates
enhancements.description: Hammered into the flesh of a Fallen Noble’s forehead and allowed to take root, this warp crystal allows them to predict their enemy’s plans and exploit them. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Once per battle round , you can target the bearer’s unit with the Command Re-roll Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if another unit from your army has already been targeted by that Stratagem this phase. In addition, you gain Lord of Deceit ability: Lord of Deceit (Aura): Each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

enhancements.name: Blessing of the Dark Master
enhancements.description: This pilot has won the favour of a sinister patron, granting them a measure of mysterious protection. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has the Stealth ability. In addition, once per battle, after you make a saving throw for the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

stratagems.name: CLAIMED FOR THE DARK GODS
stratagems.description: The Fallen Noble dedicates their latest conquest to the Dark Gods in hope of reward.
stratagems.WHEN: Start of your Command phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
stratagems.EFFECT: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control, with a Level of Control of 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: SPITEFUL DEMISE
stratagems.description: Determined that tales will be told of their spectacular end, the Fallen Noble overloads the internal generators of their Knight suit, hoping to take their enemy with them into oblivion.
stratagems.WHEN: Any phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army is destroyed.
stratagems.TARGET: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.EFFECT: When rolling to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your unit’s Deadly Demise ability, that model’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of a 4+ instead of on a 6.

stratagems.name: RUNES OF DISDAIN
stratagems.description: Inscribed into the Knight suit’s servo-skeleton, these markings channel the pilot’s contempt for the foe and manifest it as a sorcerous aura of defence.
stratagems.WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase , just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: TITANIC DUEL
stratagems.description: The Chaos Knights engage in duels not for honour, but to assert their absolute dominance over the battlefield.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.EFFECT: Select one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if that enemy unit is TITANIC , you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.name: TROPHY HUNTER
stratagems.description: To these Fallen Nobles, each new foe chased down is another opportunity to claim gory trophies.
stratagems.WHEN: Fight phase , just before a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army consolidates .
stratagems.TARGET: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: CRUSHED LIKE VERMIN
stratagems.description: Screaming enemy warriors are crushed to gory paste as the Chaos Knight tramples spitefully through their midst, stamping and raking these unworthy foes with its huge, taloned feet.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Movement phase , just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army ends a Normal move .
stratagems.TARGET: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.EFFECT: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES ) that your unit moved over during that move and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound . If one or more models are destroyed as a result of this Stratagem, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test .

detachmentRule.name: Masters of the Pack
detachmentRule.rule: By bending their tyrannical will upon their War Dog underlings, the masters of the hunt goad them to provide a constant stream of sensor data. This influx of supplementary targeting, prey-seeking and omnisensory analysis enhances the scions’ ability to hunt alongside their snarling ironclad hounds.

enhancements.name: Aspect of the Beast
enhancements.description: Something predatory and monstrous from the depths of the Warp has possessed this Knight suit. Its terrifying presence spreads like a pall. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. At the start of your Command phase , select one Dread ability to be active for the bearer until the start of your next Command phase, in addition to the Dread abilities active for your army

enhancements.name: Hunter’s Helm
enhancements.description: This infernal faceplate was forged by the cannibalistic Dark Magi of Ghanarkh. Affixed to a Chaos Knight, it infuses the steed with a carnivore’s ferocious hunger. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Octagram of Conjuration
enhancements.description: This Knight suit’s cockpit incorporates a summoning octagram that drags warp gheists into reality and sends them screaming out to bedevil rune‑marked prey. KNIGHT ABOMINANT model only. The bearer has the following ability: Octagram of Conjuration (Aura): While a friendly WAR DOG model is within 9" of this model, after that WAR DOG model has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test .

enhancements.name: Throne Tyrannicus
enhancements.description: So dominant is the psychoneural signature of this Throne Mechanicum that it dominates even other scions and their steeds as they rule over War Dogs. TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. In your Command phase , select one other CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER model within 9" of the bearer. If the bearer has one or more Aura abilities that affect friendly WAR DOG units, until the start of your next Command phase , the selected CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER model is affected by those Aura abilities as well.

stratagems.name: FERAL ARROGANCE
stratagems.description: This Chaos Knight shrugs off even the most dire hurts as though they are beneath such a mighty, warp‑empowered predator.
stratagems.WHEN: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.TARGET: That CHAOS KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds .

stratagems.name: MERCILESS FUSILLADE
stratagems.description: The scion slaves their servants’ weapons to their own, forming an overwhelming firestorm.
stratagems.WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army, and up to two friendly WAR DOG units, that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.EFFECT: Select one enemy unit that is an eligible target for each of those CHAOS KNIGHTS units. Until the end of the phase, each time one of those Chaos Knights units is selected to shoot or fight, if that enemy unit is an eligible target, you can only select that enemy unit as the target for all of those attacks and those attacks have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: BEASTHIDE MANIFESTATION
stratagems.description: The raw and bestial power of the Warp causes this Chaos Knight to sprout thick mutant scales and layered hide in response to incoming attacks
stratagems.WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase , just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: FLUSH THE QUARRY
stratagems.description: Urged on by their masters, the War Dogs push hard through the densest terrain.
stratagems.WHEN: Start of your Movement phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army and up to three friendly WAR DOG units within 6" of that Titanic Chaos Knights unit.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those War Dog units makes a Normal , Advance or Fall Back move , its models can move through models and terrain features . When doing so, they can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

stratagems.name: CONTEMPTUOUS VOLLEYS
stratagems.description: No mere prey swirling about their steed’s feet will prevent this scion from focusing their fire.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Movement phase , just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army Falls Back .
stratagems.TARGET: That CHAOS KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back .

stratagems.name: GOADED BEAST
stratagems.description: Firing upon adamantine monsters only goads them to greater wrath and more ferocious bloodshed.
stratagems.WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase , just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.EFFECT: Your unit can make a Surge move. To do so, roll one D6: models in your unit move a number of inches up to the result, but your unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT ). When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

detachmentRule.name: Marked Prey
detachmentRule.rule: Once War Dogs have singled out a victim, they target it relentlessly until it is dragged down and torn apart.

enhancements.name: Preyslayer’s Mantle
enhancements.description: This ancient War Dog chassis is said to have been forged in warpfires and ensorcelled with the spirit of the hunt unending. WAR DOG model only. The bearer has the Super-heavy Walker ability.

enhancements.name: Final Howl (Aura)
enhancements.description: Biomechanoid parasites lace a War Dog’s vox-emitters with the infernal baying of supernatural hunting hounds. Its effects upon other nearby War Dogs are profound and alarming. WAR DOG model only. While a friendly War Dog model is within 6" of the bearer, each time that model makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Loping Predator
enhancements.description: This swift attacker is adept at firing on the move, trusting the predatory senses of their War Dogs machine spirit to single out targets of opportunity. WAR DOG model only. The bearer’s ranged weapons have the [assault] ability.

enhancements.name: Panoply of the Cursed Knight
enhancements.description: Borne within by an order of silent Idolators, this collection of tattered pennants, chain-strung charms and armour scraps represent the last remains of the Knight Carnivus Grymm, torn apart by his own pack of War Dogs. It is said festooning one’s Knight suit with these charms instils the legendary fortitude of that doomed war engine, but also invites Carnivus Grymm’s ghastly end. WAR DOG model only. Each time an attack targets the bearer, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: VOX-HOWL
stratagems.description: This artificially generated vox-borne rallying cry booms out across multiple wavelengths. It bolsters the courage of fellow War Dog pilots and their steeds, even as it fills the foes’ communications with squealing scrapcode and monstrous howling.
stratagems.WHEN: Start of the Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One WAR DOG CHARACTER unit from your army.
stratagems.EFFECT: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test . Each friendly WAR DOG unit that is within 6" of your unit and is Battle-shocked must take a Leadership test ; if that test is passed, that unit is no longer Battle-shocked.
stratagems.RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

stratagems.name: HUNGRY FOR COMBAT
stratagems.description: Eager to get into battle, these War Dogs hope to win glory and prove their worth to peers and masters alike.
stratagems.WHEN: Start of the Fight phase .
stratagems.TARGET: Two or more WAR DOG units from your army within Engagement Range of the same enemy unit.
stratagems.EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of those WAR DOG units. Until the end of the phase, models in those WAR DOG units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of those WAR DOG units makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit .

stratagems.name: CUNNING HUNTER
stratagems.description: This War Dog's pilot knows when to feign fight or give ground, only to redouble their attack the moment their prey’s guard drops.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Movement phase , just after a WAR DOG unit from your army Falls Back .
stratagems.TARGET: That WAR DOG unit.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back .

stratagems.name: ANIMALISTIC RAGE
stratagems.description: Many War Dog pilots are bitter and twisted souls whose hearts are filled with animalistic rage, and they will vent that anger with their last dying gasp.
stratagems.WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase , just after a WAR DOG unit from your army that has not yet fought is destroyed.
stratagems.TARGET: That WAR DOG unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.EFFECT: Before resolving your unit’s Deadly Demise ability, it can either shoot or fight. When doing so, it must target only the enemy unit that just destroyed it, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target. After it has done so and after any Consolidation moves have been made, resolve your unit’s Deadly Demise ability as normal.

stratagems.name: HARRYING HOUNDS
stratagems.description: War Dogs fight with agility and guile, giving ground only to surge in on the attack from another angle.
stratagems.WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase , just after an enemy unit ends a Normal , Advance or Fall Back move .
stratagems.TARGET: One WAR DOG unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: ENCIRCLING PACK
stratagems.description: The War Dogs of the dread household move to outflank and encircle their prey.
stratagems.WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One WAR DOG unit from your army that is wholly within 12" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves .

detachmentRule.name: Dreaded Masters
detachmentRule.rule: Mortal thralls and foes alike are sacrificed to empower the fallen nobility.

enhancements.name: Profane Altar
enhancements.description: This ancient and thoroughly corrupted Knight suit is a walking idol of the Dark Gods and a conduit for their malign powers. As servile thralls bleed and die, so do its weapons seethe with unholy power. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer makes a Dark Sacrifice, the maximum number of models are destroyed in the selected DAMNED unit (i.e. 3 if the unit’s Leadership test is passed, or 6 if it is failed) but, until the end of the phase, the bearer’s weapons have both [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1] .

enhancements.name: Pave the Way
enhancements.description: This callous Noble dispatches teeming hordes of mutants and mortal devotees to map the path ahead and scout the battlefield for prey. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select up to three DAMNED units from your army. The selected units have the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Tyrant’s Banner
enhancements.description: A tyrannical butcher, this Noble’s Knight suit bears their corrupted house’s tattered and gore-flecked banner. This icon of depravity flutters overhead, inspiring mortal devotees to acts of sickening violence. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer makes a Dark Sacrifice, select one visible friendly DAMNED unit to take a Leadership test instead of a friendly DAMNED unit within 6".

enhancements.name: Diabolical Resilience
enhancements.description: With its pilot consumed by imperious arrogance and its systems clotted with malefic corruption, this venerable war suit refuses to yield, contemptuously shrugging off the incoming fire. CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability and you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and/or to any Advance or Charge rolls made for it.

stratagems.name: AVENGE THE MASTERS!
stratagems.description: As the object of their adulation is consumed by fire, mortal worshippers are roused to a desperate fury, seeking vengeance on behalf of their deceased master.
stratagems.WHEN: Any phase.
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, the enemy unit that destroyed your unit is Marked. Each time a DAMNED model from your army makes an attack that targets a Marked unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: WRETCHED MASSES
stratagems.description: In the wake of striding Knights are dragged tides of desperate zealots. No sooner has one horde of baying mortals fallen than another surges forth to take their place.
stratagems.WHEN: Any phase.
stratagems.TARGET: One DAMNED unit (excluding ACCURSED CULTISTS ) from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.EFFECT: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves , at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining.
stratagems.RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle. This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units .

stratagems.name: SOUL HUNGER
stratagems.description: Daemonic corruption, both physical and spiritual, has debased once noble machines. As the pilots of corrupted Knight suits slaughter mortal victims, their mechanical steed feeds upon stolen life forces and raw fear.
stratagems.WHEN: Fight phase , just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army has fought.
stratagems.TARGET: That CHAOS KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.EFFECT: If one or more models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, your unit regains up to D3 lost wounds. If one or more models from Battle-shocked units were destroyed as a result of those attacks, your unit regains up to D3+2 lost wounds instead.

stratagems.name: UNRESTRAINED RAGE
stratagems.description: When consumed with battlelust, Fallen Nobles pilot their Knight suits with instinctive skill, rampaging through the enemies with horrific speed and savagery.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Movement phase , just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army Advances or Falls Back .
stratagems.TARGET: That CHAOS KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.name: WORTHLESS CHATTEL
stratagems.description: The callous nobility of Iconoclast houses care naught for their devotees, obliterating enemies and mortal thralls alike in furious barrages of infernal firepower.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Shooting phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One DAMNED unit from your army.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, one model from your unit is destroyed after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

stratagems.name: PRESERVE THE IDOLS
stratagems.description: Driven to preserve their Fallen Noble overlords, masses of mutants, cultists, and corrupted soldiers rush to interpose themselves between their knightly idols and the cursed foe.
stratagems.WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase , just after an enemy unit ends a Normal , Advance or Fall Back move .
stratagems.TARGET: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.EFFECT: Select one DAMNED unit from your army that is not Battle-shocked , not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is within 6" of your unit. That DAMNED unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", but it must end this move closer to that enemy unit than when it started the move.
